hub.title: Knowledge base: file formats, encodings, time and money math explained — cv.cm
hub.description: Clear, sourced explanations of HEIC, JPG vs PNG vs WebP, EXIF, DPI, Base64, UTF-8, URL encoding, hashes, UUIDs, Unix time, ISO 8601, time zones, APR vs APY and margin vs markup.
hub.lede: Short, sourced explanations of the formats, codes and numbers you meet every day. Each article answers the question first, then explains why, with links to the standards and to a free tool that runs in your browser.
about: Tutorials on cv.cm show how to get a job done. These articles explain what is going on underneath: why a photo is HEIC, why a PDF is 40 MB, why a password with four random words beats one with symbols.
Every article is checked against the published standard or official documentation listed under Sources, and dated so you can see when it was last reviewed.

faq.a: The cv.cm team writes them and checks each fact against the standards and official documentation listed at the end of every article.

faq.q: Can I use the tools mentioned here for free?
faq.a: Yes. The linked tools are free, need no account and process files in your browser.

faq.q: How is a knowledge article different from a tutorial?
faq.a: A tutorial walks through one task step by step. A knowledge article explains the idea behind it, such as how a format or a formula works, so you can make your own decisions.
